Extract ReefCloud tier IDs by geographic name

Source: R/extract_tierid.R
extract_tierid.Rd

Searches the ReefCloud lookup table for one or more geographic names and returns the corresponding tier IDs. Only lookup rows with observations are searched.

Names are matched against the following columns:

  • tier2_name: country-level names; returns tier2.

  • tier3_name: regional names; returns tier3.

  • tier4_name: sub-regional names; returns tier4.

Matching ignores case, accent marks, and leading or trailing whitespace. For example, "Islas de la Bahia" matches "Islas de la Bahía". Otherwise, the full name must match; partial names are not supported.

If a row has the same normalized name in tier2_name and tier3_name, its tier3 ID is excluded in favour of tier2. Tier4 matches are unaffected by this rule.

A name may match multiple locations or tiers. All matching IDs are returned, subject to the tier3 exclusion above, with duplicates removed. Matching a country name does not automatically return the IDs of its regions or sub-regions.

Usage

extract_tierid(
  name,
  lookup_file = "extdata/reefcloud_dashboard_tier_lookup.csv"
)

Arguments

name

A character vector containing one or more geographic names. Missing values and empty or whitespace-only names are not allowed.

lookup_file

Path to a UTF-8 CSV containing tier2, tier2_name, tier3, tier3_name, tier4, tier4_name, and contains_data.

Value

An unnamed vector of unique tier IDs, ordered by input name and then by tier2, tier3, and tier4 matches within each name. An error is raised if any supplied name has no eligible match or if a matching ID is missing.
